tasks.title: Radio Astronomy: A New Perspective
paras: Radio astronomy is the study of celestial objects using radio waves rather than visible light. Unlike optical telescopes, radio telescopes can detect signals from sources obscured by dust or too faint to be seen with traditional instruments. This branch of astronomy has led to transformative discoveries, including the detection of cosmic microwave background radiation-a faint glow left over from the Big Bang-which has enabled scientists to reconstruct the universe's early conditions.

One of the most famous radio astronomy discoveries was the identification of pulsars in 1967. These rapidly spinning neutron stars, the dense remnants of massive stars that have exploded, emit beams of radio waves at regular intervals. Observing pulsars helps scientists understand the end stages of stellar life and the behavior of matter under extreme conditions.

However, radio astronomy faces growing challenges due to technological interference. Devices like mobile phones,wireless routers, and satellites emit radio frequencies that can overwhelm the faint cosmic signals astronomers seek to detect. This "Y radio frequency pollution" makes it increasingly difficult to isolate genuine astronomical data. To combat this, observatories are often located in remote areas and protected by radio quiet zones, but the global spread of wireless technology continues to pose a serious threat.

questions.stem: What does the comparison of optical and radio telescopes suggest?

options.A: Traditional instruments are more susceptible to damage.
options.B: Dust often interferes with the optical detection of objects in space.
options.C: Radio telescopes are best for detecting massive stars.
options.D: Optical telescopes were the first to detect cosmic microwave background radiation.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：推理题 原文定位：Unlike optical telescopes, radio telescopes can detect signals from sources obscured by dust or too faint to be seen with traditional instruments.正确答案分析：文中将射电望远镜与光学望远镜对比，指出射电望远镜可以探测被尘埃遮挡的天体，反过来说明尘埃会干扰光学望远镜的观测。 选项分析： (A) 传统仪器更容易受损 —— 错误，文中未提及设备损坏问题。 (B) 尘埃常常干扰对太空天体的光学探测 —— 正确，obscured by dust 直接说明尘埃对光学观测的阻碍。 (C) 射电望远镜最适合探测大质量恒星 —— 错误，文中说探测的是脉冲星（恒星爆炸后的残骸），不是大质量恒星本身。 (D) 光学望远镜最先探测到宇宙微波背景辐射 —— 错误，这是射电天文学的发现。

questions.stem: The word "transformative"in the passage is closest inmeaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：词汇题 原文定位：This branch of astronomy has led to transformative discoveries… 正确答案分析：transformative 意为 “变革性的、突破性的”，groundbreaking（开创性的、突破性的）含义最接近。 选项分析： (A) groundbreaking 开创性的 —— 正确。 (B) exciting 令人兴奋的 —— 错误，侧重情绪，不是 “革命性”。 (C) concerning 令人担忧的 —— 错误，情感色彩相反。 (D) startling 令人吃惊的 —— 错误，不强调重大改变。

questions.stem: According to the passage,radio astronomy helps scientists study all of the following EXCEPT

options.B: how to prevent the explosions of large stars
options.D: the way matter behaves under extreme conditions

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节排除题 原文定位： reconstruct the universe's early conditions understand the end stages of stellar life the behavior of matter under extreme conditions 正确答案分析：文中提到射电天文帮助研究宇宙早期、恒星末期、极端环境下的物质行为，但完全没有提到阻止恒星爆炸。 选项分析： (A) 宇宙的开端 —— 正确，属于研究内容。 (B) 如何防止大质量恒星爆炸 —— 错误，文中无相关内容，为本题答案。 (C) 恒星的最后阶段 —— 正确，对应 end stages of stellar life。 (D) 物质在极端条件下的行为方式 —— 正确，原文直接提及。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention "the global spread of wireless technology'?

options.A: To suggest that the issue of technological interference is not likely to end soon
options.B: To argue that technological interference is not as severe as was once thought
options.C: To support the argument that optical telescopes are more reliable than radio telescopes
options.D: To highlight the sophisticated tools astronomers use to detect cosmic signals

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：…but the global spread of wireless technology continues to pose a serious threat. 正确答案分析：作者提到无线技术在全球普及，是为了说明无线电干扰问题会持续存在、难以解决。 选项分析： (A) 表明技术干扰问题不太可能很快结束 —— 正确，continues to pose a threat 体现问题持续存在。 (B) 认为干扰没有以前认为的严重 —— 错误，文中强调威胁严重。 (C) 证明光学望远镜更可靠 —— 错误，无此对比意图。 (D) 强调天文学家使用的精密设备 —— 错误，与设备无关。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what is one way to address the issue of technological interference?

options.A: Revive the use of optical telescopes
options.B: Limit wireless routers to certain frequencies
options.C: Place observatories far away from urban areas
options.D: Mandate specific quiet times when the use of wireless technology is prohibited

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节题 原文定位：To combat this, observatories are often located in remote areas and protected by radio quiet zones… 正确答案分析：文中明确提出的应对方法是将天文台建在偏远地区，远离干扰源。 选项分析： (A) 重新使用光学望远镜 —— 错误，文中未提及。 (B) 限制无线路由器的频率 —— 错误，无相关内容。 (C) 将天文台安置在远离城市的地区 —— 正确，对应 located in remote areas。 (D) 强制设定禁止使用无线技术的静默时段 —— 错误，文中是 “无线电静默区”，不是定时禁用。
